title: How Axios uses AI to help deliver high-impact local journalism
summary: Axios COO Allison Murphy explains how the company uses AI to support local reporters, streamline newsroom workflows, and deliver high-impact local journalism at scale.
body: Axios COO Allison Murphy explains how the company uses AI to support local reporters, streamline newsroom workflows, and deliver high-impact local journalism at scale.
summaryZh: Axios通过集成AI技术优化了新闻采编工作流，旨在提升本地新闻报道的效率与规模。该案例展示了AI在媒体行业辅助内容生产的实践。
